messages:
Noah: Heads up — monitoring alerted a drop in GPU quota for us-west2 (A100 pool). Seeing scheduler 403s for some tenants. Any recent terraform changes?

ops-bot: [ALERT] quota_change_detected us-west2-a100 reduced from 120 -> 80 at 2025-03-18T00:01Z :warning:

Harper: I pushed a TF change earlier for nightly rebalancing, sorry for the churn. I'm going to roll that target back now — pinging in-thread so it's logged.

Ajay: Ping @oncall — we should validate this rollback won't starve the Dedicated pools. Also confirm spot/eviction fallback still healthy.

Harper: Rollback initiated. Command: 
```
terraform apply -target=module.gpu_quota -var="env=prod" -auto-approve
```
Quick log: 
```
Apply complete! Resources: 1 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed.
Quota patch reverted: us-west2-a100 -> 120
```

Noah: Thanks. I'm seeing fewer 403s but a handful of tenants still see failures — retrying queued jobs and draining where necessary. Could this be a vendor-side transient reduction?

Maria: Procurement note: vendor sent an advisory — they're reallocating a small tranche for emergency maintenance this window. PO RF-2219 referenced. Im opening contact now, ETA unknown.

procurement-bot: Vendor ticket created: TICKET-8421 — vendor scheduling maintenance affecting us-west2 capacity. Link: https://vendor.example/tickets/8421

Ajay: OK — consolidating actions: 1) Harper validate canary smoke in 30m, 2) Noah run tenant retry loop and capture failing tenant IDs, 3) Maria escalate vendor ETA and request interim bump, 4) I'll open an infra incident and set page if SLA impact persists.

Harper: Canary smoke running now against the 3-node canary. Initial p99 latency and success rates look fine, no OOMs. Will report back by 00:45Z.

Noah: Started retry script: `./scripts/retry_failed_jobs --region us-west2 --only-gpu` — clients are starting to resume :thumbsup: Captured failing tenants: tenant-512, tenant-884 (sending to support).

Maria: Vendor replied — can provision temporary +20 quota for 2 hours if we sign a short invoice addendum. They can do it within ~15m. Pushing finance/legal to fast-track.

Ajay: Good. Ive created incident INC-20250318-01 and linked TICKET-8421. Keeping pages on until vendor confirmation. Thanks everyone for quick rollback and follow-ups.

Harper: Follow-up: pushing a small TF guard to prevent future midnight rebalances from touching production quota without a two-person approval. Will open PR.

Noah: Nice, thanks. Closing loop once vendor confirms full restoration.
